maya: T-minus 6h before EU change window. Quick readiness check — green for freeze at 03:00 UTC? @ops-oncall please confirm :eyes:

sam: Staging smoke passed across 3 hosts. Embedding service latency stable. One flaky ember test (/tests/embeddings/roundtrip) — rerunning now.

lee: DB migration scripts reviewed. We scheduled read-only window 03:00-03:10 for schema swap. I need early pin approval for migration container image: redwood/inference:v3.4.1-migr.

jamie: Approve pin. v3.4.1-migr pinned for migration job only. Will roll back if any lock contention. :thumbsup:

rachel: QA canary passed on edge-2. Rollback path tested — traffic shift script validated. Logs attached: https://go/reports/canary-4410

ops-oncall: Oncall here — standby for 02:45 handoff. Runbook updated: https://go/runbooks/eu-change-window
I'll monitor error-rate > 2% and latency P95 > 300ms.
Alert channel is #release-war-room.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-04-01T03:15:00Z. Pin applied to canary nodes.
Command: /deploy canary --image=redwood/inference:v3.4.1-migr --timeout=15m

maya: Quick checklist before freeze:
```
- confirm backups ✅
- DB read-only window scheduled ✅
- canary smoke ✅
- rollback tested ✅
- comms: #release-war-room ✅
```
Anything missing?

sam: Double-checking backups retention. One minor metric alert in staging (disk io) — mitigated by throttling, not a blocker.

lee: Adding grace hold: if canary error >1% for 5m, abort and unpin. Otherwise proceed to staged rollout at +30m.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll post handoff at 02:45 UTC and watch the canary. ping me for manual unpin if needed.

maya: Ok proceeding. I'll open the launch freeze (03:00-05:00 UTC) and post final go/no-go 02:50 UTC. :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Freeze window created: 2026-04-01T03:00:00Z - 2026-04-01T05:00:00Z. Change ticket: CHG-441012
Automated rollback policy: on errors >=2% within 10m -> rollback to v3.4.0
